case: Sunday: "this week" asked on the week's last day is the coming week

parts.quote: What is on for the family this week?

answers.text:
This week the family has Parents' evening on Tuesday, 20 October, Football training on Wednesday, 21 October, Swimming lesson and Piano lesson on Thursday, 22 October, Dinner at Nona Marija's on Friday, 23 October, and an U13 match on Saturday, 24 October.  
Tasks include Practise reading on Monday, 19 October and Sign the school trip form on Tuesday, 20 October.
